headline: Rupiah Weakens Again Today to Rp 18,219 Per US Dollar
summary: The rupiah fell again to Rp 18,219 per US dollar. Capital Economics said Japan's economic weakness does not necessarily change the monetary policy direction of the Bank of Japan.
why: The rupiah's exchange rate against the dollar affects import costs, inflation and the foreign-currency debt burden of Indonesian companies and the government.
